#!/bin/zsh
#flux: --account=VeloC
#flux: --nodes=4
#flux: --time=0:45:00
#flux: --mail-user=thomas.bouvier@inria.fr
#flux: --tasks-per-node=8
# The Cobalt queue directive '-q full-node' does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# This is typically handled by resource constraints or queue policies on the target system.
# The Cobalt attribute '--attr filesystems=home' is a site-specific data-staging
# request that has no standard equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# The 'mpiexec' command has been replaced with 'flux run'.
# The total task count '-np 32' and tasks per node '-npernode 8' are now handled by the
# #flux directives ('--nodes=4' * '--tasks-per-node=8' = 32 total tasks).
# The '-hostfile' and process mapping/binding flags are omitted as Flux manages this automatically.
# The '-x' flags for environment variable export are handled by running the command in the current shell context.
#flux run python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_naive_resnet18_scale --log-level info
#
# To more closely match the OpenMPI `mpiexec` behavior, we explicitly use `flux mini run`
# with the `pmi=pmix-openmpi` option.
flux mini run --pmi=pmix-openmpi -n 32 -N 8 python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_naive_resnet18_scale --log-level info

issues: The script sets a very specific `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` that includes an OpenMPI installation (`.../openmpi-4.1.4.../lib`). It then uses `flux mini run --pmi=pmix-openmpi...`, which suggests an attempt to use Flux's process management with an external MPI library. This can be a fragile configuration and can lead to runtime conflicts, library mismatches, or other unexpected failures. It is strongly recommended to build and run the application against the MPI implementation provided by or integrated with the Flux environment for better stability.

The job script requests CPU resources (`--tasks-per-node=8`) but does not request any GPUs. However, the `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` includes CUDA libraries, and the spack environment (`spack-envs/thetagpu`) suggests GPU usage. If the `main.py` application requires GPUs, the job will fail because the necessary hardware was not requested in the job directives.

#!/bin/zsh
#COBALT -A VeloC
#COBALT -n 4
#COBALT -t 0:45:00
#COBALT --mode script
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT --attr filesystems=home
#COBALT -M thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
mpiexec -np 32 -npernode 8 -hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE -bind-to none -map-by slot -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x WANDB_MODE -x PATH python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config baseline_naive_resnet18_scale --log-level info
